subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should `fetchConfiguredLocalOriginWithSsrFGuard` and `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` become public `ssrf-runtime` Plugin SDK exports, or must this fix preserve owner-scoped private access?
rationale: The PR changes an SDK/security boundary that current comments, owner-scoped aliasing, and guardrail tests intentionally keep private; automation cannot choose that public contract for maintainers.

options.title: Preserve owner-scoped access
options.body: Keep these helpers private to Browser/Ollama and repair the package lazy-load path through the existing private alias or another narrow owner-scoped mechanism.

options.title: Approve public SDK promotion
options.body: Accept the public exports only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs/API metadata, guardrail updates, and package smoke proof.

options.title: Choose a canonical sibling
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer another open candidate PR or a fresh replacement as the canonical repair for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve owner-scoped access
recommendation.body: Keep these helpers private to Browser/Ollama and repair the package lazy-load path through the existing private alias or another narrow owner-scoped mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre authored the merged private SSRF runtime alias/package-gating that defines the current owner-scoped boundary.
